girl1.prompt_en: Young female with long straight black hair, blunt bangs, and sidelocks; an oval face, serious expression, small nose, and large eyes with defined light-colored irises. She wears a traditional Japanese martial arts uniform consisting of a white long-sleeved kimono-style top (gi) and dark pleated trousers (hakama). She actively wields a wooden sword (bokken).
girl1.prompt_ch: 年轻女性，留着黑直长发、齐刘海和鬓角；瓜子脸，表情严肃，小鼻子，大眼睛，浅色虹膜轮廓分明。她身穿传统的日本武术服（白色长袖和风上衣和深色褶皱袴）。她活跃地挥舞着一把木剑（木刀）。

man1.prompt_en: Young adult male with short messy black hair; wide eyes, an unusually long and comical pointed nose, and rounded rectangular glasses; wearing a simple, light-colored collared shirt.
man1.prompt_ch: 年轻的成年男性，留着凌乱的黑色短发；大眼睛，异常长且滑稽的尖鼻子，戴着圆角矩形眼镜；身穿一件简单的浅色翻领衬衫。

Plot Correspondence.en: girl1 glares suspiciously at man1, who hides nervously and wonders if her previous threats were genuine.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 女孩1满脸狐疑地盯着男人1，而男人1紧张地躲起来，怀疑她之前的威胁是否当真。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. An outdoor or semi-outdoor corridor. One long horizontal wooden railing spans the midground from the center to the right edge.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。一个室外或半室外的走廊。一根长长的水平木制栏杆横跨中景，从中心延伸到右侧边缘。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 is on the left side of the screen, revealing only her sharp, suspicious eyes and blunt bangs. On the right side, in the background, man1 cowers behind the wooden railing, wearing glasses and peeking over it with an anxious expression.
Static Shot Description.ch: 女孩1在画面左侧，只露出她锐利、怀疑的眼睛和齐刘海。在画面右侧的背景中，戴着眼镜的男人1蜷缩在木栏杆后面，带着焦虑的表情偷看。

Plot Correspondence.en: Declaring him a suspicious person, girl1 fiercely lunges forward to attack.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 女孩1大喊他是可疑人物，并凶狠地向前猛扑发起攻击。

Setting Description.en: Abstract action background filled with dense, vertical speed lines emphasizing sudden impact and intense motion. Exact quantity: one wooden sword, one dark scabbard bag.
Setting Description.ch: 抽象的动作背景，充满密集的垂直速度线，强调突然的撞击和强烈的运动感。确切数量：一把木剑，一个深色剑袋。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 lunges dynamically, positioned in the center and facing screen right. She holds the hilt of one wooden sword with her left hand near her waist, while her right hand is raised entirely empty above her head. In the foreground to the right, one dark scabbard bag is falling away. Her expression is fierce and commanding.
Static Shot Description.ch: 女孩1充满动感地向前猛冲，位于画面中央，面向画面右侧。她左手在腰间握着木刀的刀柄，右手完全空着高举过头顶。在右侧的前景中，一个深色的剑袋正在掉落。她的表情凶狠而威严。

Plot Correspondence.en: The wooden sword violently embeds itself into a pillar right next to man1's face, leaving him completely terrified.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 木剑猛烈地嵌入紧挨着男人1脸部的柱子中，让他陷入了极度恐惧。

Setting Description.en: Close-up on a wooden structural pillar and a horizontal wooden ledge. The background consists of dense vertical speed lines emphasizing the sudden shock of the impact. Exact quantity: one wooden pillar, one horizontal wooden ledge, the tip of one wooden sword.
Setting Description.ch: 木制结构柱和水平木制壁架的特写。背景由密集的垂直速度线组成，强调撞击带来的突然冲击。确切数量：一根木柱，一个水平木壁架，一把木剑的刀尖。

Static Shot Description.en: man1 is positioned on the right side of the screen, cowering defensively behind a wooden pillar. He wears glasses and has a terrified expression with wide, dot-like eyes and sweat drops. Both of his hands are tightly gripping the horizontal wooden ledge at the bottom of the frame, and he is looking towards the left. On the left side of the screen, the tip of girl1's wooden sword is embedded deep into the pillar just inches from his face, emphasizing the near miss.
Static Shot Description.ch: 男人1位于画面右侧，在木柱后做出防御性的退缩姿势。他戴着眼镜，表情惊恐，双眼睁大如圆点并挂着汗滴。他的双手紧紧抓住画面底部的水平木制壁架，向左看去。在画面左侧，女孩1的木剑刀尖深深嵌入柱子中，离他的脸仅有几英寸，强调了这有惊无险的一幕。

Plot Correspondence.en: girl1 towers over man1, coldly accusing him of peeping after he had been hitting on other girls, an accusation he frantically denies.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 女孩1高高在上地俯视男人1，冷冷地指责他在搭讪其他女孩后又来偷窥，而男人1拼命否认这一指控。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. An outdoor setting with a clear sky and soft, sparse clouds in the background. Exact quantity: one wooden sword, one small stick.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。室外场景，背景是晴朗的天空和柔和、稀疏的云彩。确切数量：一把木剑，一根小棍子。

Static Shot Description.en: In the bottom left foreground, man1 is seen from the back in a panicked state, wearing glasses, his spiky hair standing on end as one small stick hits the back of his head. In the center midground, girl1 stands tall and imposing, facing forward and looking slightly down towards the bottom left corner at man1. Her arms are crossed, resting one wooden sword vertically against her shoulder. She glares down at him with a cold, condescending expression.
Static Shot Description.ch: 在左下角的前景中，可以看到处于惊恐状态的男人1的背影，他戴着眼镜，当一根小棍子击中他后脑勺时，他那刺猬般的头发竖了起来。在中景中央，女孩1高大威严地站立，面向前方，微微低头俯视着左下角的男人1。她双手交叉，将一把木剑垂直靠在肩上，带着冰冷、居高临下的表情怒视着他。

Plot Correspondence.en: girl1 explicitly tells man1 that unlike the others, she has not accepted his presence there.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 女孩1明确地告诉男人1，与其他前辈不同，她并没有接受他在这里。

Setting Description.en: Daytime. A clear sky background with a faint cloud.
Setting Description.ch: 白天。带有淡淡云彩的晴空背景。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1's face is in the center of the frame. She stares slightly off-center to her right (screen left) with a resolute, unwavering glare.
Static Shot Description.ch: 女孩1的脸位于画面中央。她带着坚定、毫不动摇的怒视，目光略微偏向她的右侧（画面左侧）。

Plot Correspondence.en: Blushing slightly but completely serious, girl1 warns that she will forcefully kick him out if he tries anything funny.
Plot Correspondence.ch: 女孩1虽然脸颊微红但表情极其严肃，她警告说如果他敢有任何不轨举动，就会用武力把他赶走。

Setting Description.en: Entirely blank white background. Exact quantity: one wooden sword, one small text box.
Setting Description.ch: 完全空白的白色背景。确切数量：一把木剑，一个小文本框。

Static Shot Description.en: girl1 occupies the center of the frame. She is looking directly forward with a serious expression and a subtle blush on her cheeks. She holds one wooden sword horizontally and slightly diagonally across her chest. A small text box containing the word '実力' (force) points downwards directly towards the sword's grip.
Static Shot Description.ch: 女孩1占据画面中央。她表情严肃地直视前方，脸颊上有淡淡的红晕。她将一把木剑水平且略微倾斜地横在胸前。一个小文本框内写着“実力”（武力），正向下指向木剑的握柄。
